test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

A team of doctors has been sent to the worst affected area to_______ the patients there.
solution:
The correct answer is 'treat.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is talking about **sending a team of doctors to the worst affected area for the patients there**.
 
• The use of the word 'patients' in the sentence indicates **people who are receiving medical treatment**.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'treat'.
 
• The word 'treat' means **to use medicine or medical care to try to make a sick or injured person well again**. 
 
 
• Example:* New ways to **treat** arthritis may provide an alternative to painkillers*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete Sentence: *A team of doctors has been sent to treat the worst affected area to the patients there*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let us explore the other options:

 
 
• 'Experiment' means **a scientific test that is done in order to get proof of something or new knowledge**. (नई जानकारी या प्रमाण के लिए किया गया वैज्ञानिक प्रयोग)
 
• '**Result**' means **something that happens because of something else; the final situation at the end of a series of actions**. (परिणाम, नतीजा, फल)
 
• '**Conduct**' means **to organize and do something, especially research**. (व्‍यवस्थित रूप से कुछ करना, विशेषतः अनुसंधान-कार्य)

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य **मरीजों के सबसे ज्यादा प्रभावित इलाके में डॉक्टरों की टीम भेजने की बात** कह रहा है।
 
• वाक्य में 'patients' शब्द का प्रयोग उन लोगों को इंगित करता है **जो चिकित्सा उपचार प्राप्त कर रहे हैं**।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'treat' है।
 
• 'Treat' शब्द का अर्थ है **किसी बीमार या घायल व्‍यक्ति का इलाज करना**।
 
 
• उदाहरण: *New ways to treat arthritis may provide an alternative to painkillers*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: *A team of doctors has been sent to treat the worst affected area to the patients there*.
